hooks.command:
py=$(for c in python3 python; do "$c" -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "$c"; break; }; done); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && "$py" -c 'import json,sys,subprocess
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
p=(d.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path","")
if not p.endswith(".py"): sys.exit(0)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"tools/lint.py"],capture_output=True,text=True)
if r.returncode:
    sys.stderr.write(r.stdout+r.stderr); sys.exit(2)'
py=$(for c in python3 python; do "$c" -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "$c"; break; }; done); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && "$py" tools/check_portable.py
py=$(for c in python3 python; do "$c" -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "$c"; break; }; done); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && "$py" .claude/hooks/post_merge_reminder.py
py=$(for c in python3 python; do "$c" -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "$c"; break; }; done); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && "$py" .claude/hooks/ui_visual_verify_gate.py
